text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will discuss efforts to save the peace process. Arafat arrived in Cairo on Wednesday night.

- Egypt's export committee will discuss in its coming meeting ways to expand high technology export industries and solve problems with tariffs. The meeting headed by Mubarak will discuss ways to increase agricultural output and improve the trade balance.
- Saudi and Egyptian ministers today will hold a meeting of their joint committee in economic, tourism, political and investment fields.
- Oil minister Hamdi el-Banbi said Egypt and Jordan will discuss in the coming week the extension of a natural gas export pipeline to handle 400 million square feet a day.

- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri will head a ministerial committee on Saturday to review economic performance and inflation. The committee will discuss reports on international finance establishments, the World Bank and support for efforts to raise the standard of living and private sector participation. The reports see average economic growth rising to 5.5 percent from the second half of the year, inflation shrinking to 6 percent, and foreign reserves at $20 billion.
- Social Development Fund and Egyptian American Bank signed an agreement worth 10 million pounds to finance 330 handicraft and small projects for youth.
